question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =

Earlier each and every person (e) ⎯⎯ very careful of social value. But at present our social value is in a great threat. Young people don't (f) ⎯⎯ their elders duly that results in social degradation. As a result, peace and order and decent life are greatly (g) ⎯⎯. So, with a view to (h) ⎯⎯ peace and order in society, social value is badly (i) ⎯⎯. Without social value, we can't (j) ⎯⎯ decent, comfortable, happy and peaceful life.
